visual_text: A low HbA1c on insulin or gliclazide: ask two questions
Have there been any low blood sugars?
HbA1c shows average blood sugar. It does not show low sugars.
Norfolk: about 3 in 10 people aged 70+ with type 2 diabetes on these drugs had HbA1c below 53 mmol/mol
Hambling et al., Diabet Med 2017; Strain et al., Diabet Med 2018
alt_text: Dark question card: a low HbA1c on insulin or gliclazide, ask two questions. Have there been any low blood sugars? Is this dose still needed? A schematic line graph, not measured data, shows blood sugar dipping below a dotted average line. HbA1c shows the average, not low sugars. In Norfolk about 3 in 10 people aged 70+ on these drugs had HbA1c below 53.
design_instructions: Single dark teal card. Gold numbered steps for two questions; mint panel with schematic SVG line (blood sugar with two dips below a dotted average line), Schematic badge, HbA1c note and Norfolk figure. No evidence chart.
